source.name: StatsBomb Open Data
source.licenseNote: Attribution and StatsBomb logo required for published analysis.

method.coordinates: StatsBomb 120 × 80 event coordinate system; Barcelona attacks left to right.
method.averagePosition: Mean origin of each player's completed open-play passes.
method.network: Directed completed open-play passes; links with fewer than two passes are omitted.
method.flows: Up to 42 Barcelona possessions per match that reached x ≥ 80 or ended in a shot; paths are downsampled to 18 points.
